submission.justification: Crystal-K2 is excluded by the hard background constraint: its assayed intrinsic background is 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day (100–3000 keV), four times the 0.5 budget. Of the two remaining candidates, K1 has the lowest background (0.10) but poor resolution (8.4% at 5 cm, 10.4% at 2 cm, 12.6% at 10 cm). K3 has background 0.30 ± 0.05, which is within budget, and gives much better resolution. Scanning K3 thickness with the simulation gave FWHM of 4.97% (2 cm), 4.74% (3 cm), 4.48% (4 cm), 4.63% (5 cm), 4.57% (6 cm) and 6.37% (10 cm). The optimum is at about 4 cm, with 4.48% FWHM at 662 keV. Because the 2025 summary used a nominal 5 cm crystal, these values come from the new simulation runs.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Crystal-K3 is one of the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: Intrinsic background 100-3000 keV must not exceed 0.5 counts/kg/day (hard)
requirements.evidence: Q1 2026 assay: Crystal-K3 = 0.30 ± 0.05 counts/kg/day, which is within budget. K2 (2.0) is excluded; K1 (0.10) also passes.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Among background-compliant options, K3 at 4 cm gives 4.48% FWHM, versus 8.4% (K1, best at 5 cm) and 4.6–5.0% for K3 at other thicknesses checked. K2 would be best on resolution (2.9% in 2025 summary) but fails the background constraint.
